## Statement · **draft**
Let $R, S$ be rings with identity. A map $f : R \to S$ is a **ring homomorphism** if

$f(a+b) = f(a)+f(b), \qquad f(ab) = f(a)f(b), \qquad f(1_R) = 1_S$

for all $a, b \in R$.
